values.en: Every Head Normal Form Is a Weak Head Normal Form
values.zh-CN: 首标准型必为弱首标准型

values.en: Every head normal form is a weak head normal form, but not conversely. For example, `λx. (λy. y) z` is in weak head normal form but not in head normal form.
values.zh-CN: 每个首标准型都是弱首标准型，反之不成立。例如，`λx. (λy. y) z` 是弱首标准型，但不是首标准型。
